races.name: Elf (High)
races.blurb: Graceful, keen-eyed and long-lived, with a touch of magic.

races.name: Dwarf (Hill)
races.blurb: Stout, stubborn and hard to kill.

races.name: Half-Elf
races.blurb: At home in two worlds and charming in both.

races.name: Half-Orc
races.blurb: Fierce and enduring; hard to put down.

races.name: Dragonborn
races.blurb: Proud draconic folk who breathe elemental fire.

races.name: Tiefling
races.blurb: Touched by the infernal; clever, magnetic, distrusted.

classes.name: Fighter
classes.blurb: Master of weapons and armour. Simple, sturdy, reliable.

classes.name: Barbarian
classes.blurb: Furious warrior who shrugs off blows.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.blurb: Sneaky, skilled and deadly from the shadows.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.blurb: Hunter and tracker of the wild places.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.blurb: Scholar of arcane magic. Fragile but powerful.

classes.name: Sorcerer
classes.blurb: Born with raw magic in the blood.

classes.name: Warlock
classes.blurb: Gained magic through a pact with something powerful.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.blurb: Divine healer and warrior of a god.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.blurb: Holy knight bound by an oath.

classes.name: Monk
classes.blurb: Martial artist who fights with fists and focus.

classes.name: Druid
classes.blurb: Keeper of nature, wielding its magic.

classes.name: Bard
classes.blurb: Performer whose words and music carry magic.

presets.blurb: Great at what your class does best, weak elsewhere.

scene.title: The Drowned Lantern — taproom
scene.description: A low-beamed harbour inn, half sunk into the mud.

characters.name: Torvald
features: Second Wind (bonus action: heal 1d10 + level, once per rest)

characters.name: Elowen
features: Spellcasting (INT): cantrips Fire Bolt, Mage Hand, Light; prepared from Magic Missile, Shield, Sleep, Burning Hands, Detect Magic, Mage Armor; 2 first-level slots

present.name: Old Brannock
present.description: The innkeeper. One eye, many opinions.

log.text: Mira the Halfling (Lightfoot) Rogue joins the party.
Torvald the Dwarf (Hill) Fighter joins the party.
Elowen the Elf (High) Wizard joins the party.
The adventure begins.

Rain hammers the shutters of the Drowned Lantern. Old Brannock wipes the same mug for the third time, watching the door.
Somewhere below the floorboards, water drips in a slow, patient rhythm.
I slide onto a stool at the bar and order whatever is warm.
"Who rings a bell under the sea, old man?"
Brannock stops wiping. "Nobody living," he says, and sets down a steaming bowl of fish stew in front of Mira.
Can I tell if the dripping comes from a cellar?
You can try. Listen closely to where it comes from.
Elowen rolled Wisdom (Perception) check: 14 +3 = 17 — success
Beneath the long table, a trapdoor. The planks around it are wet and newer than the rest.
